details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (profitability metrics), K2 (loan portfolio growth), K3 (deposit growth), K4 (customer base expansion), K6 (funding and guarantees), K7 (capital ratios), K10 (dividends), and K11 (EEEF loan). However, it omits the strategic targets outlined in K5, sustainability initiatives described in K8, product/service launches mentioned in K9, and the management board appointment in K12. These omissions are material for K5 (HIGH importance) and represent significant missing components for the MEDIUM items (K8, K9, K12). The summary captures most HIGH-importance items but lacks one HIGH item (K5) and several MEDIUM items, resulting in a Generally yes rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of Coop Pank's 2025 performance. The summary shows a clear structure: starting with overall performance (S1), then detailing income components (S2-S5), expenses and ratios (S6), credit quality (S7), tax and returns (S8-S9), business volumes and loan/deposit growth (S10-S14), operating environment context (S15-S16), funding actions (S17-S18), rating affirmation (S19), equity and capital ratios (S20-S21), and dividend information (S22). There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational problems. While there is a minor decline in profitability (S1, S2, S6, S9), this is consistently explained by lower interest rates throughout the summary (S1, S3, S15, S16). All numerical changes are presented with clear directional indicators and context. The summary forms a coherent whole without unnecessary repetition.
